# Damview Resort

> A hospitality resort in Chitungwiza, Zimbabwe, built around lodges, a swimming pool, a restaurant and bar, a gym, and outdoor activities on the water in Chikwanha.

## About
Damview Resort is a physical, operating resort - not a software product. It offers overnight lodge stays, a day-entry pool and dam area, a restaurant and bar, a gym with group fitness classes, and recreational activities including boat cruises and pedal boats. It also hosts private events and runs a youth sports academy on Saturdays.

## Location
Chikwanha, along Seke Road, next to Zuva Service Station, Chitungwiza, Zimbabwe. Open 24 hours, every day.

## Contact
WhatsApp/phone: +263774446001 (primary), +263774446004 (secondary). Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/damviewchitown/

## Accommodation
Lodge rooms across four blocks (Garden, Poolside, Premier, Riverside), bookable for a full-day stay or by the hour. Payment is by EcoCash.

## Pricing
Day entrance: $2 on weekdays, $3 on weekends. Gym membership from $30/month. Exact lodge, event, and activity pricing is shown live on the relevant page, since it can change.
